thread:
Alex K: Quick heads-up — vendor pen test is tentatively set for next Thurs. Need to lock scope: KMS, RBAC changes, audit logging, and the readroom evidence flow. Can someone own the intake sheet + remediation tracker?
Priya S: I can take the intake + triage sheet. will create a tab for evidence + presigned uploads. link when ready.
Morgan L: I'll handle RBAC gating and a freeze window proposal. We should ensure no config deploys 48h prior.
Alex K: @sec-oncall FYI — any oncall constraints for the window? also we might need a dedicated escalation contact during the test.
sec-oncall: Keep me in the loop. I'm available during the window but prefer no unplanned deploys. Post any critical alerts to #incidents and ping me.
infra-bot: Scheduled snapshot: nightly infra-snapshot at 03:00 UTC.
Alex K: That's the problem — infra snapshot (and a config rollout) could change logs. Morgan, can we suppress non-essential infra jobs during the window?
Morgan L: Yes. proposing: freeze from T-48h to T+6h. suppress: infra-snapshot, autoscaling policy changes, and infra config pushes. keep backups and monitoring on.
Priya S: created tracker: https://docs.internal/redwood/pen-test-intake-7723456789 (draft). Tabs: intake, triage, remediation, evidence. Uploads: presigned S3 links per-assessment.
Alex K: Perfect. Add a column for "evidence owner" + "evidence link" + "audit export (Y/N)". Also add a checkbox for KMS key-material proof.
sec-oncall: Two quick asks: 1) We need CloudTrail/CMSK audit export for the readroom timeframe. 2) Ephemeral role creds for assessors limited to read-only and limited by IP.
Morgan L: For KMS proofs we can provide key metadata + creation timestamps, plus an HSM sig for key-wrapping ops. We need to confirm with infra which KMS keys are in-scope.
Priya S: I'll add an "in-scope resources" checklist. please populate with services/ARNs.
Alex K: Also: vendor asked about RBAC change history. We should prepare a short list of recent IAM role changes and a diff patch.
Morgan L: I can export IAM change logs. snippet for reference: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutRolePolicy --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2024-03-30
```
Priya S: Upload format for evidence: single ZIP per finding + md file describing repro steps and timestamps. presigned link TTL = 7 days.
sec-oncall: We should also capture token-level audit info from the inference runtime for any requests that triggered findings. put that under "telemetry evidence" in the tracker.
Alex K: Good call. Morgan, can runtime team produce a trace export for a given request_id window?
Morgan L: yes, but we need precise request ids or time ranges. recommend we create a small playbook: 
- how to request trace export (who to ping)
- retention expectations
- redaction rules (PII)
I'll add it to the tracker.
deploy-bot: Notice: a minor config deploy (service/router) is scheduled in 36 hours.
Alex K: Uh — that's inside T-48h freeze. Morgan, can you cancel or reschedule that deploy?
Morgan L: I'll abort the scheduled deploy and push to backlog. leaving a note in the deploy ticket.
Priya S: Logistics: can we offer a 2-hour readroom slot per day for interactive Q&A with the vendor during the engagement? helps speed up triage.
sec-oncall: That works. suggest 14:00-16:00 UTC as default. I'll attend for escalation.
Alex K: One more: retest coordination. vendor wants 2 retest slots within 2 weeks after fixes. Let's assign retest owner and required evidence packaging standard for retest validation.
Priya S: I'll add a "retest owner" column and a checklist: patch applied, unit test evidence, infra snapshot, audit export for validation window, and exploitation attempt logs.
Morgan L: Also note: if an RBAC change is part of remediation, we must coordinate a canary deploy to staging + a policy to revert to previous role definitions if the retest fails.
Alex K: Agreed. action items: 
- Priya: share tracker link + create evidence template (by EOD)
- Morgan: confirm freeze & cancel deploys (T-48h) + list in-scope KMS keys (by EOD)
- sec-oncall: confirm readroom times and point person for emergency contact (by EOD)
- Alex: prepare IAM change diffs and runtime trace playbook (by EOD)
Priya S: done — tracker created and invited vendor + security list. please fill your sections. :thumbsup:
sec-oncall: I'll post the readroom calendar invite once we confirm final test date. cc @Morgan L
Morgan L: noted. starting work on KMS list now.
Alex K: Thanks all. we'll reconvene after tracker is populated.
Priya S: quick Q — for evidence uploads, do we need kms-wrapped ZIPs or just presigned S3? some teams prefer wrapped artifacts.
sec-oncall: presigned S3 is fine, but for high-sensitivity artifacts use KMS-encrypted ZIPs. mark that on the tracker per-finding.
Priya S: Roger. adding guidance.
Alex K: End-to-end checklist: freeze confirmed, tracker live, readroom tentative. Moving to follow-ups in the tracker. :lock:
